svg.title: Nahe study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Nahe; 2: Monzingen; 3: Meddersheim; 4: Schloßböckelheim; 5: Niederhausen; 6: Norheim; 7: Bockenau; 8: Bad Kreuznach; 9: Münster-Sarmsheim; 10: Langenlonsheim

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
